[10] (ran3_cr_chunks 38.463, sim=0.6012)
[CR CR0726r1 for 38.463] Reason for change: In R3-204502, the resource status report related procedures were introduced, but the Assigned Criticality of the Registration Request IE and Reporting Periodicity IE were not aligned in tabular and asn.1. Considering of the functionality, and aligned with XnAP and F1AP, it is better to use criticality reject for the Registration Request IE, and use criticality ignore for the Reporting Periodicity IE. It is also noticed that the Report Characteristics IE was defined as Size 32 in the tabular but 36 in the asn.1. Although in XnAP and F1AP the similar IE is defined as size 32, considering of backward compatibility, it is better to change the tabular to align with asn.1. Summary of change: In the tabular, change the Assigned Criticality of the Regist
